name: 03-image-tool
query: Give me a Midjourney prompt for a hero image: a lone lighthouse in a storm, moody and cinematic, for a website banner.
expected_behavior: Reads references/tools-visual.md and does not read tools-llm.md or tools-agentic.md
Output contains exactly one fenced prompt block
In the generated prompt, the text preceding the first '--' parameter contains at least 4 commas
That same text contains no '.', no '?', no '!' and no ';'
Every Midjourney parameter used appears in the documented parameter list in references/params.md
The string '--style raw' does not appear anywhere in the response
If a version is pinned with --v, the value matches the current default recorded in references/params.md
The generated prompt contains the string '--no' followed on the same line by at least one word
The line after the prompt block starts with '🎯 Target:' and names Midjourney
The response contains no '⚡ Framework:' line and no '💰 Tokens:' line
